research_metadata.coverage_notes: Mustang is a remote, mountainous district in Gandaki Province, Nepal. Higher education options within the district are extremely limited. Mustang Multiple Campus is the primary and most prominent higher education institution in the district. Other +2 programs exist under secondary schools, but they do not operate standalone qualifying higher education programs.

identity.name: Mustang Multiple Campus

identity.description: Mustang Multiple Campus serves as a vital center for higher education in the remote Mustang district of Gandaki Province, Nepal. Affiliated with Tribhuvan University, it offers undergraduate programs catering to local students who would otherwise have to travel to Pokhara or Kathmandu for higher studies.
